resources.string: Automatic gradient correction. For a large nebula, exclude the target in Advanced.
Tap sky, refine in the loupe, then Add. Tap an existing circle to remove it. Avoid stars and nebulae; cover all four corners.
Add at least 12 usable sky samples across the image.
Move overlapping or invalid samples to separate sky areas.
All optional. Choose only the masters you have; empty slots do not prevent stacking.
Calibration is fixed for the current stack. Reset it before changing masters.
Save any result you need first. This clears the live stack and offline workspace so you can change calibration.
Cover the telescope or camera completely to block all light.
Cover the telescope completely. Let the camera reach the temperature used for your target.
Keep the filter, camera angle and focus unchanged. Use a uniformly lit flat panel or evenly lit white cover.
Turn auto exposure off. Keep gain, offset, ROI and hardware bin unchanged; use the shortest stable exposure.
Turn auto exposure off. Match the target exposure, gain, offset, ROI and hardware bin. Darks are never exposure-scaled.
Turn auto exposure off. Keep gain, offset, ROI and bin; adjust exposure to place the histogram around 30–60%, without clipping. Select BIAS first if available.
Record 20–50 frames in SER, then stop. Return here and choose the recording to build a master. Restore target settings before observing.
For missing capture info, I confirm matching camera settings, dark exposure/temperature, and flat filter/optics.
Use no master of this type
No masters yet. Capture a short sequence or use an existing recording.
Capture settings are missing. Check compatibility, tick the confirmation, then choose the master or recording again.
The calibration frames do not match this source. Check camera settings, image size, CFA, exposure and filter.
The flat is too dark, clipped or has invalid pixels. Adjust uniform lighting and exposure, then capture again.
Choose a raw SER or PSER recording.
Capture settings changed during this recording. Capture a new sequence with fixed settings and auto exposure off.
A selected master could not be loaded. Reselect it in Calibration or choose None.
Master saved. Select it below to apply it to the next stack.
Delete this derived master? The original recording is kept.
Deselect this master before deleting it.
